sources.snippet: MLX 4-bit (affine, group size 64; head-wise attention gate kept in bf16) weights of XHToken/Spark-X2.6-4B, redistributed unchanged from the community conversion abenzerps/Spark-X2.6-4B-MLX-4bit (model.safetensors SHA-256 matches its SHA256SUMS.txt). Only the six files an on-device loader needs are included.
